newsitem.title: UK: Palm oil ends lower on quiet European veg oil mark.
newsitem.headline: Palm oil ends lower on quiet European veg oil mark.

text.p: Palm oil prices finished lower in Europe on Friday at the end of a quiet session.

Traders said there was the usual end-week lack of interest among buyers coupled with the feeling that the palm market has been over bought recently and talk in Malaysia that the next set of palm oil export figures will be lower than expected.
"People are talking of lower palm oil prices, but I don't think anything dramatic will happen," said a trader.
Soft oils closed mixed with soy and rape oil sellers offered at even money.
Lauric oils were lower in tradeless markets.
Crude palm oil cif Europe closed unchanged to $2.50 down after Jan and Mar both traded at $562.50 a tonne cif.
Products finished with sellers $2.50 to $7.50 lower with no further business reported during the afternoon.
Dutch soy oil closed unchanged after spot traded at 97 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
Rape oil was mixed with sellers 0.25 guilders down to 0.75 guilders up after Mar/Apr traded at 97.75 and May/Jul at 99 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
Coconut oil was $5 down at the close while palmkernel oil finished unchanged to $2.50 lower in tradeless markets.
